text:
alex-eng: Hey @people-ops — I missed open enrollment and need to add my partner's child (stepchild) as a dependent. We just finalized custody papers yesterday. Is late enrollment possible?
maya-people-ops: Congrats on custody! :tada: Yes, adding a dependent due to a qualifying life event (change in household) is usually allowed if we get docs within 30 days of the event. Can you DM the event date and attach the court docs or birth certificate?
alex-eng: Thanks! Event date is 2026-03-10. I can upload scanned custody order and the child's birth certificate. One question: will coverage be retroactive to 3/10 or to the first of next month?
maya-people-ops: If it's a QLE and we receive valid proof within the allowed window, coverage is effective on the date of the event for medical/dental/vision. Payroll deducts retro premiums back to that date. HR will calculate retro amount and it posts on the next paystub. We'll also need the child's SSN for carrier enrollment.
alex-eng: Got it. Is there a secure place to upload SSN? don't want to put it in Slack.
benefits-bot: Upload your documents securely here: https://benefits.redwood.com/secure-upload (requires SSO). Choose "Qualifying Life Event" and attach PDFs. ETA for processing: 3-5 business days after receipt.
maya-people-ops: Also cc'ing @ben-payroll to flag potential retro deduction so payroll can estimate timing.
ben-payroll: Thanks @maya-people-ops — we'll queue a retro deduction estimate once docs hit the portal. Typically shows up on the following pay cycle; if large, we can spread over 2 pay periods on request. FYI: if portal fails, email payroll@redwood.com with subject: "Retro QLE - Alex M - 3/10/26"
alex-eng: Appreciate it. I'll upload docs today. One more: do I need to update dependent in ADP as well or will benefits team sync?
maya-people-ops: We submit enrollment to the carrier and sync with ADP. No action needed after upload besides providing SSN. I'll post here when it's submitted.
alex-eng: Uploaded now (files: custody_order.pdf, birth_cert.pdf). SSN included in secure upload form.
benefits-bot: Upload received: ticket #BR-2026-349. Processing queue position: 4. Estimated completion by 2026-03-19.
maya-people-ops: Thanks — marking as received. @ben-payroll, please estimate retro and set to "spread over 2 paychecks" unless Alex requests otherwise.
ben-payroll: Got it, I'll run numbers and reply here by EOD tomorrow.
alex-eng: Thanks all. Appreciate the quick help :pray:
